name: button
title: Button
description: A matching set of action controls in six looks: a light filled primary, a dark secondary, an outlined one, a ghost with no fill, a red destructive and a plain text link, all sharing one rounded rectangle and small medium text.
use: You need a small set of matching action styles that share one shape and sizing scale.
avoid: Colours come from theme tokens, so the exact look shifts with the host app's palette.
a11y: It is a real native control with visible text and a focus ring; reduced motion is not handled, but only colour shifts animate. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single row of six short rounded controls on black. The first is filled light with dark text, the second dark grey, the third clear with a thin border, the fourth pure text, the fifth salmon red and the last a bare text link.
behaves: Static: no press or hover effect is caught in the frames. In the code each variant darkens its fill on hover, the link one underlines, and keyboard focus draws a soft ring.
customise: The label is children, variant picks one of six looks, size picks one of four heights, and asChild renders a link instead. Any native attribute passes through.
weight: light: A styled native control with colour and shadow transitions only.
demo: Six controls labelled Button, Secondary, Outline, Ghost, Destructive and Link.
issues: No frame shows a hover or pressed state, so the variants are only seen as static fills
Ghost and Link look almost the same on the black stage
polishWhy: Even, consistent variants; ghost and link are hard to tell apart on the dark stage.
